Spacecraft SERPENS
Type CubeSat

Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2015-09-17
Entity name SERPENS (Sistema Espacial para Realização de Pesquisa e Experimentos com Nanossatélites) programme university consortium
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters Brazil
Launch brokerer JAXA
Oneliner

Demonstrate store and forward messaging and plasma propulsion.
Description

Transponder to test VHF and S-band communications for store and forward messaging, a UHF transponder fully compatible with the HUMSAT store and forward messaging system and pulsed plasma thruster (PPT) built by Mars Space Ltd. and Clyde Space.
